summary: A fiction excerpt (Book 10, part 54) in which Trish and Damian, driving a tiny two-seater, find themselves in a dead spot after the grid goes down. Trish, acting as navigatrix, teases Damian about his lack of paper maps, then finds an old-fashioned phone left behind by his mother. They realize it can reach a tower directly and call Damian's mother, Trish explaining that the grid is down, the car's navigation is out, and the Interstate is jammed. The passage is comedic and establishes their playful rapport.
one_line: Trish and Damian, stranded in a dead spot after a grid outage, use an old phone left by Damian's mother to call for directions.
key_facts: Trish tells Damian that they need to manually route themselves out of the dead spot and get back on the grid.
Trish, who calls herself navigatrix, tells Damian that he is the pilot and asks him to tell her where his maps are.
Damian jokes that his maps are with the sextant and sundial, between his leeches and his obsidian sacrifice-knife.
Trish says every car has a couple of maps and that they self-assemble from happy meal boxes.
Trish claims she learned that drivers are allowed on the shoulder when routing goes down from the written-test manual, studying with her little cousin Leelee.
Trish finds an old-fashioned phone in the glove compartment, which Damian says his mom left behind a couple years ago.
Trish reasons that the phone can unmesh and talk straight to a tower at a long distance, so it works in dead spots and can be used to get directions.
Trish and Damian discovered their ability to make each other laugh when he farted while taking off his kilt on their second date.
Damian recites his mom's number and Trish calls her, introducing herself as Damian's friend.
Trish tells Damian's mom that the grid is down, the car has no nav system, the dolby is out, and the Interstate is a parking-lot.
